ads.text: Thinking about rooftop solar but not sure whom to trust? Watch this Hyderabad customer share their real experience - from site survey to installation and subsidy guidance. No sales talk. ad_library.summary: mrsolar.in has exactly one active Meta ad - a Hyderabad customer-review video that has been running since 5 May 2026, over five months on the same creative. The click goes to an fb.me link, not to a specific page on mrsolar.in. The site itself (fetched 2026-10-22) is the fullest asset in this batch: an ISO 9001:2015 badge, PM Surya Ghar subsidy content including the Rs 78,000 central subsidy and 300 free units, a savings calculator, an eligibility form, a WhatsApp button (wa.me/918500911912) and city pages for Hyderabad plus seven other Telangana towns. None of that machinery is referenced by the ad copy beyond a passing 'subsidy guidance'.

findings: One live ad, running since 5 May 2026 - over five months on a single customer-review video with no second creative angle behind it.

The ad's click goes to an fb.me wrapper, while mrsolar.in already has the landing assets a subsidy-motivated click wants: the PM Surya Ghar Rs 78,000 subsidy page, the savings calculator and the eligibility form.

The site positions itself as an 'unbiased consumer reviews of Telangana & AP solar companies' destination with an ISO 9001:2015 badge and city pages for Hyderabad, Karimnagar, Warangal, Siddipet, Nalgonda, Rangareddy, Medchal and Malkajgiri - a trust story the one ad never tells.

Contact paths on the live site are split three ways: the contact page lists info@mrsolar.in and contact@mrsolar.in with +91 8500225885, while the floating WhatsApp button uses a different number, +91 85009 11912.
